reviews.title: Review
reviews.text: The most accurate spiritual guide ever!!
reviews.reply:
Hello,

Moments like that can feel very personal and reassuring, and it’s great to know it made that kind of impact. If you ever need support or have questions, please contact us at support-appstore@asknebula.com, we’ll be happy to help.

reviews.title: Unpleasant experience
reviews.text: If you are subscribed to this app and you will try to cancel your plan or your subscription it will be hard so I canceled my Visa card and ordered a new one because it is way easier plus the support that I got from AI chat was not useful and didn’t help much
reviews.reply:
Hi, thank you for letting us know about your experience — we’re truly sorry to hear how frustrating this was for you. We understand how stressful it can feel when canceling doesn’t go as expected, and we never want any user to reach the point of replacing their card. 

Please know that every subscription on Nebula can be managed or canceled directly through your account settings, and once a plan is canceled, no further charges should occur. We’d really like to look into your case in detail and help make things right. Whenever you’re ready, please reach out to us at support-appstore@asknebula.com — our team will review everything carefully and provide proper assistance.

Best wishes,
Nebula Team 🔮

reviews.title: Thieves

reviews.reply:
Hello,

Thank you for sharing your feedback with us.

We’re very sorry to hear about the unexpected charge related to your subscription — we completely understand how upsetting this must feel. 
This is definitely not the experience we want for our users.

Please reach out to us at support-appstore@asknebula.com so we can review your subscription and assist you with the next steps to resolve the situation. 
We truly appreciate you taking the time to let us know about your experience and will do our best to make things right.

Warm regards,
Nebula Team 🔮

reviews.title: Ugh
reviews.text: I just downloaded the app and I can’t even type in my date of birth because it crashes every 10 seconds. what am i supposed to do?
reviews.reply:
Hello,
 
Thank you for your comment.
 
We kindly ask you to try to perform the next actions:
1. Delete the app from your mobile device.
2. Install the app again. 
3. Click "Restore" button on a subscription screen.
 
Let us know if the issue has been resolved.
